faqItems.q: How do I make a claim?
faqItems.a: Open Home and tap Submit a claim on your pet’s card. Add the visit details and a photo of the receipt. At contracted clinics with direct payment you don’t need to claim at all.
Vet care up to your yearly limit. You can see how much cover you have left on the Home screen and in Insurance & claims.

faqItems.q: Who can see my pet’s information?
faqItems.a: Only you and the family members you add. You decide when to share the health passport with a vet or pet sitter, and you can stop sharing at any time.

faqItems.q: Does the app replace a vet?
faqItems.a: No. TassuVahti helps you keep an eye on your pet between visits. If you are worried, always contact a vet.

faqItems.q: How do I change the language?
faqItems.a: Go to Profile and pick Suomi, Svenska or English under Language.

profile.supportIntro: We’re happy to help with insurance, claims and the app.
profile.emergencyNote: Is your pet acutely ill? Find the nearest emergency clinic under Clinics.
accessibilityBody: We want everyone to be able to use TassuVahti. The app aims to meet the WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

Health status is always shown with a colour, an icon and a word, so it can be read without colour vision. Text follows the size set on your phone, and every button works with screen readers such as VoiceOver and TalkBack.
Known issues: the clinic map is a picture, so use the clinic list below it instead.
Found something that doesn’t work for you? Tell us through Customer service and we’ll fix it.
